title: Rational engineering of an antimalarial peptide with enhanced proteolytic stability and preserved parasite invasion inhibitory activity
content:
RSC Chem. Biol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4CB00229F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Abhisek Kar, Akash Narayan, Vishal Malik, Kalyaneswar Mandal
Chemical peptide engineering with D-amino acids, added disulfide bonds, and covalent stitching improved a chimeric peptide's plasma stability while preserving target affinity, marking a significant advance in therapeutic peptide engineering.
